notes: The Wireless PRO is a 3-piece system: 2x bodypack transmitters (TX), 1x receiver (RX), and a Smart Charge Case (accessory, sold as part of the kit). This entry models the RECEIVER, the unit that interfaces with cameras/computers/phones in a signal chain. Receiver ports: 3.5mm TRRS analog output (unbalanced; per RODE's user guide it also doubles as a headphone output with its own gain control) and USB-C (functions simultaneously as digital audio interface, USB bus power, and charging input) - RODE advises against using both outputs at once (ground-loop risk) but both are physically present. USB-C grade omitted for the receiver's own port since RODE does not publish a USB speed class for it (it operates as a USB Audio Class device, not a rated high-speed data port). Each TRANSMITTER (not separately modeled here) has: 1x locking 3.5mm TRS mic/lav input and 1x USB-C charge-only port (no audio/data, so excluded from grading rules as charge-only). The SMART CHARGE CASE (not separately modeled) has its own USB-C port used for charging plus SuperSpeed data offload (RODE ships an SC34 cable rated to 5Gbps for exporting 32-bit float on-board recordings from docked units) and a USB-C power input; if modeled separately its data port would take grade usb-5g. No AC mains inlet exists anywhere in the system - all charging is via USB-C bus power/PD, so no nema-5-15/iec port applies. Desktop/handheld unit, not rack-mountable (rackUnits omitted). Confidence is medium because RODE's own consolidated datasheet page (help.rode.com) returned 403 Forbidden; specs were assembled from RODE's official product and user-guide pages plus a retailer spec table (Precision Camera) that mirrors RODE's datasheet format and is the most complete/consistent source found.

ports.name: Output
ports.note: 3.5mm (1/8-inch) TRRS unbalanced analog output; also usable as a headphone/monitor output with independent gain control.

ports.name: USB-C
ports.note: Functions as digital audio interface (stereo output), USB bus power input, and charging port simultaneously. No published USB speed class for this audio-interface port.
